chunks: But if they see a sign they turn away, and say: 'This is the same old lie continuing,'
ai.seo_question: How did the disbelievers react to the signs of God according to Surah Al-Qamar?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Qamar, this verse highlights the persistent stubbornness of the Quraysh, who dismissed Prophet Muhammad's miracles as 'continuous magic' (sihr mustamirr) to avoid acknowledging the truth. Shia exegetes often view this as a precursor to the eventual divine punishment, illustrating how arrogance blinds the heart to clear signs.
